# HirePulse Apify Actor directory

> Fifteen public Actors verified October 22, 2026. Public/native mode describes source selection, not free execution. Check each Actor's live Pricing and Input tabs. Unavailable measurements remain unknown.

## Connect

- Remote MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/<actor-slug>`; comma-separate multiple Actors.
- Authentication: Apify OAuth where supported, or `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`. Do not put tokens in public URLs or logs.
- Use a spending limit before running an Actor. A saved example is not proof of a successful current run.


## ATS Detector: Find a Company's Job Board (Free) (`hirepulse/ats-detector`)

Find a public ATS job-board URL from a company domain.

**Limits:** No Actor fee; Apify platform usage can cost money. Missing boards are not proof that a company is not hiring.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-detector
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-detector/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/ats-detector`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "linear.app",
    "ramp.com"
  ]
}
```

## ATS Job Scraper: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable & More (`hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`)

Read supported public ATS boards and return jobs or a company summary.

**Limits:** Coverage depends on supported boards and accessible evidence; missing salary data stays unavailable.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "companies": [
    "stripe.com",
    "linear.app",
    "ramp.com"
  ]
}
```

## Google Jobs Alternative: ATS & Public Job Listings (`hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`)

Search supported public career and ATS job listings by query.

**Limits:** Default public mode is an alternative source route, not measured live Google Jobs SERP coverage. Availability and fields vary.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json

  "queries": [
    "data engineer"
  ]
}
```

## B2B Account Research Agent: Hiring, Tech, Ads & Contacts (`hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`)

Combine selected hiring, technology, ads and contact sources into an account dossier.

**Limits:** Source Actor fees and parent fees are separate. Optional connector writes require explicit operations and opt-in; disabled in the example.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "domain": "linear.app",
  "sections": [
    "hiring",
    "technology",
    "ads",
    "contacts"
  ],
  "maxResultsPerSource": 3,
  "use_paid_upstream": false,
  "allowConnectorWrites": false
}
```

## Company Intent Radar: Hiring, Ads & Website Signals (`hirepulse/company-intent-radar`)

Combine observed hiring, public ad, website and DNS evidence with an explainable intent estimate.

**Limits:** A score is a heuristic, not proof of buying intent, growth or ad spend. Public mode does not measure SEO traffic.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/company-intent-radar`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "notion.so"
  ]
}
```

## Website Tech Stack Detector: BuiltWith Alternative, Bulk API (`hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector`)

**Limits:** Static observations can miss dynamically loaded technologies; no exhaustive detection guarantee.

## Company Contacts Finder: Emails, Phones, Socials & DNS (`hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder`)

Extract available public website emails, phone numbers and social links, with optional DNS checks.

**Limits:** MX records describe domain email infrastructure; they do not verify that a mailbox exists or accepts mail.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "domains": [
    "stripe.com",
    "linear.app",
    "mailchimp.com"
  ]
}
```

## Domain SEO Overview: Metadata, Sitemaps & Keywords (`hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`)

Inspect page metadata, sitemap observations, autocomplete suggestions and available CrUX popularity tiers.

**Limits:** Native mode does not measure traffic, Google rankings, search volume or CPC. A CrUX tier is a popularity bucket, not visits.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview/pricing

```json
    "stripe.com"
  ]
}
```

## Keyword Research: Google Autocomplete & Suggestions (`hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`)

Generate Google autocomplete suggestions and keyword research ideas by seed, country and language.

**Limits:** Native mode does not measure monthly search volume, CPC or difficulty; unavailable measurements remain null.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume/pricing

```json

  "keywords": [
    "keyword research tool",

  ]
}
```

**Limits:** Not image search. Fields depend on source availability; no guarantee of seller details, reviews or shipping-cost data.

## YouTube Transcript Scraper: Bulk Videos, Shorts & Timestamps (`hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`)

Fetch available captions and timestamped transcripts for supplied YouTube video URLs.

**Limits:** Videos can be unavailable, blocked or lack captions. Bulk video input is not a promise of channel discovery.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "videos": [
    "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ",
    "https://youtu.be/jNQXAC9IVRw"
  ]
}
```

## MCP & x402 Evidence Grader (`hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader`)

Inspect observed MCP catalogs or unpaid x402 challenges and produce a heuristic evidence report.

**Limits:** Not official Glama certification. Generated drafts require review; no remote changes or payment is made by the check.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "server_url": "https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp",
  "target_type": "mcp",
  "auto_fix": false
}
```

Audit structural AI crawler readiness, including robots rules, metadata and llms.txt observations.

**Limits:** Not measurement of brand citations or ranking inside ChatGPT, Gemini or other AI answers.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ai-search-brand-visibility-radar
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/ai-search-brand-visibility-radar/pricing

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "domain": "linear.app",
  "competitor_domains": [],
  "category_keywords": [],
  "generate_ready_llms_txt": true
}
```

## Store Catalog to llms.txt Draft (`hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator`)

Generate an llms.txt catalog draft from a store with an accessible public catalog.

**Limits:** Coverage is not universal; blocked stores may be unsupported. Does not write to a Shopify root or deploy the draft.

- Actor and current input/output documentation: https://apify.com/hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator
- Pricing and billing events: https://apify.com/hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator/pricing
- MCP: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator`

**Example input:** A configuration example only; not executed by this update.

```json
{
  "store_url": "https://www.untuckit.com",
  "max_products": 5
}
```
